title: fragment.rs: Missing padding validation for ALL_1 fragments
description:
In Fragment::from_bytes (line 200-201), padding validation only applies to non-ALL_1 fragments:

```rust
if fcn != ALL_1_FCN && data[data.len() - 1] & 1 != 0 {
    return Err(FragmentError::NonZeroPadding);
}
```

ALL_1 fragments use the same 1-bit-shifted wire format and should also have zero padding in the LSB of the final byte. The missing check allows non-canonical encodings to be accepted.

Impact: Defense-in-depth gap. The padding bit is not used during parsing (dead data), so this does not cause data corruption. However, accepting non-canonical wire formats could:
- Cause interoperability issues with strict implementations
- Complicate replay detection if raw bytes are used for deduplication

Fix: Remove the `fcn != ALL_1_FCN &&` condition to validate padding for all fragment types.
close_reason: Fixed: Removed the fcn != ALL_1_FCN condition from padding validation in Fragment::from_bytes. ALL_1 fragments use the same 1-bit-shifted wire format, so non-zero padding in the LSB should be rejected for all fragment types.
